lead_in: Happy to share one. Quick check first so I point you at the right thing:

questions.duration: How long has this been going on for, is this a new feeling, or something that's been building for a while?
questions.history: Have you felt this way before, or does this feel different or new to you?
questions.onset: Did this come on after something, a stressful thought, situation, or moment, or did it start suddenly without an obvious reason, even while resting or asleep?
questions.quality: Is this the same kind of feeling you've had with anxiety before, or does anything about it feel different, like sharp or crushing pain rather than tightness, pain spreading to your arm, jaw, or back, real trouble breathing rather than shallow breathing, or numbness or weakness on one side?
